user.title: Set up VomeSync
user.description: Enter the server URLs. Leave Personal Key empty to generate a new one on the next step. Public mode is NOT private — anyone with the UID can view or toggle the switch.

generate_key.title: Generate a personal key
generate_key.description: Tick consent to create and store a personal key on the VomeSync server for authentication. You can delete it later from the integration options (GDPR delete key).

data.consent: I consent to storing a personal key on the VomeSync server for authentication.

error.generate_key_failed: Could not generate a personal key. Check network access to the server.
error.invalid_uid: UID must be a valid UUID.

create_switch.title: Create a switch
create_switch.description: Create a switch owned by you. Publicise will list it publicly so anyone can toggle it.

subscribe_switch.title: Subscribe to a switch
subscribe_switch.description: Enter a switch UID to monitor. You can find public UIDs at remoteswitch.vome.io.

manage_switches.title: Manage switches
manage_switches.description: Select a switch to view, edit, or delete

connect_website.title: Connect to VomeSync website

edit_switch.title: Edit switch
edit_switch.description: Update switch settings (only owners can edit)

manage_api_keys.title: Manage API keys
manage_api_keys.description: API keys allow webhook authentication without exposing your personal key. You have {api_key_count} key(s).

create_api_key.title: Create API key
create_api_key.description: Create a new API key for webhook authentication. Give it a label to identify its purpose.

delete_api_key.title: Delete API key
delete_api_key.description: Are you sure you want to delete API key {api_key}? This cannot be undone.

error.create_failed: Failed to create switch. Check server URL, key, and connectivity.
error.connect_failed: Failed to create session token. Check server URL/key and try again.
error.fetch_failed: Failed to fetch API keys from server.

abort.no_switches: No switches to manage. Create or subscribe to switches first.
abort.not_owner: Only switch owners can edit settings.
